country_context_filter.rule: Exclude questions that require a particular respondent country, actual national government, or national 'us', without identifying that shared referent in the question/options. country_context_filter.authorization: User identified undefined country references as a general failure pattern, then instructed: yes filter these out.
country_context_filter.method: Question/option-only review; explicit per-item decisions with evidence; no model calls or debate outcomes used.
country_context_filter.scope_notes: Only unresolved country context is excluded in this pass. No country is supplied, no question/options are rewritten, and no source-country distribution is used to assign a model a nationality. Historical context, missing preceding turns, factual-vs-opinion status, and survey coding remain for later review.
country_context_filter.numbering: Keep original review_number and archive_index; do not renumber remaining questions.
